content: crystalisdisassembly (NES) measures and reports coverage using a Mesen Code/Data Log: 'PRG Analysis 92.19% Complete (18.74% Code, 73.45% Data, 7.81% Unknown)' and a parallel CHR (graphics) percentage - a concrete, reproducible, tool-generated coverage metric rather than an asserted one; its build script also diffs the reassembled ROM byte-for-byte against a supplied original when present.
